title: cdk-construct-redshift-cluster examples (all languages)
description:
Create runnable examples in packages/cdk-construct-redshift-cluster/examples/.

Scenarios:
- minimal/ — required props: subnetIds from bridge fixture vpc.database_subnet_ids, adminPassword placeholder
- single-node/ — clusterType single-node (divergent: numberOfNodes ignored)
- multi-node/ — clusterType multi-node with numberOfNodes
- encrypted/ — kmsKeyArn from bridge fixture (divergent: customer-managed encryption)
- with-logging/ — loggingEnabled, loggingBucketName from bridge fixture logs.bucket_name
- with-snapshot/ — snapshotIdentifier (divergent: restore from snapshot)

All 5 languages. Assertion tests in test/redshift-cluster-examples.test.ts.
